title: Priv: control-plane→node sync gap causing orphan RBAC bindings and KMS key metadata loss
creator: Amira Patel
description:
Summary:
A regression in the control-plane → node-agent synchronization path has resulted in deltas being marked applied before associated KMS key metadata and audit annotations were fully persisted. Consequences observed in private customer clusters: orphaned RBAC bindings on nodes (users/service-accounts could not assume expected roles), missing kms_key_id on encryption audit records, and intermittent SSO session failures when audience normalization logic ran concurrently with the sync window. Multiple enterprise customers reported failures to create or decrypt service tokens and compliance alerts for incomplete audit entries.

Scope and impacted systems:
- Control-plane delta broker (delta-applier service) and node-agent streaming consumer
- RBAC policy application path (role binding creation + tenant cache)
- KMS envelope metadata propagation path and audit log enrichment
- Identity gateway SSO audience normalization (racing with delta application)
- Private deployments using customer-managed KMS or KMS proxy

Immediate customer symptoms reported:
- 2 enterprise customers (acct-redwood-enterprise-17, acct-cobalt-ops) unable to decrypt service tokens produced in last 24h
- Compliance monitor flagged ~1.2k audit entries missing kms_key_id for the last 6 hours
- Several sessions dropped with IdP errors that map to audience mismatch during token exchange

Root cause hypothesis (initial):
A change merged in runtime delta-applier (release candidate for control-plane throttling) introduced optimistic acking of sync messages when persistence was queued but not committed. When the persistence path for KMS metadata or audit enrichment ran slower (disk/fsync or transient DB lock), subsequent node reconcilers observed RBAC state without required metadata, creating bindings that cannot be fully validated. Concurrent SSO normalization on the identity gateway also mutated the expected audience claim, leading to failed assertions for sessions initiated in the narrow race window.

Immediate mitigation performed:
- Rolled back the optimistic-ack code path on delta-applier to ensure durability-before-ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/3187 (merged, reverted optimistic ack).
- Published a temporary feature-flag to delay node-agent apply until metadata-enrichment is confirmed. Flag: controlplane.sync.strict_apply=true (toggled in affected tenants).
- Triggered a targeted backfill job to populate missing kms_key_id in audit records for affected timeframe. Backfill job: https://internal.redwood.com/jobs/5462/backfills/kms-metadata (run started 2026-03-14T03:12Z).
- Identity gateway patch to normalize audience claims earlier in the pipeline to avoid race-triggered assertion failures. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-gateway/pull/1221 (merged).

Current status and verification steps:
- Rollback of optimistic ack confirmed in canary control-plane cluster; no new missing-metadata audit entries observed for 45m across canary hosts.
- Backfill job is ~60% complete; estimate finish in 2.5 hours.
- Twenty-minute smoke test run against canary tenant passed: service token create/decrypt, RBAC checks, and audit log enrichment validated. Test artifacts: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=private-sync-incident-22456#smoke-tests
- Customer communications sent via support to affected accounts and CSMs; scheduled maintenance window if global rollout required.

Action plan (next 72 hours):
1) Finish backfill and verify audit log completeness for affected windows. Owner: Kai Nguyen.
2) Deploy strict_apply toggle removal: replace feature-flag with durable transactional commit path in delta-applier to avoid needing flag. Implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/3199 (in review). Owner: Maria Kovacs.
3) Add atomic apply at node-agent so RBAC binding + KMS metadata are applied in a single transaction locally; include circuit-breaker if metadata enrichment times out. Owner: Devon Brooks.
4) Harden identity gateway SSO flow with deterministic audience normalization and add unit + integration tests. Owner: Priya Shah.
5) Postmortem and compliance-ready incident report including retention of original audit entries and proof of backfill success. Owner: Amira Patel.

Follow-ups and long-term mitigations:
- Add end-to-end integration tests that validate RBAC + KMS metadata propagation under artificial delays.
- Instrument delta pipeline with a new metric: unapplied-delta-age and a saturation alarm if > 5s for > 1% of messages.
- Add chaos tests that inject DB fsync delays into the persistence path to exercise backpressure handling.
- Update runbooks and on-call playbooks to include the strict_apply toggle and backfill runbook steps.

Risks and trade-offs discussed:
- Strict durability-before-ack increases tail latency for control-plane acknowledgement; mitigated by targeted batching improvements planned in runtime-1.20.
- Backfill writes will create additional load on audit DB; we scheduled backfill during low-traffic window and rate-limited writes.

Customer communication notes:
- Notified affected customers at 2026-03-14T04:05Z via support-portal and reached out to account leads for verbal update.
- Suggested short-lived maintenance window if global rollout required; offered rollback plan and testing window.

Links and artifacts:
- Incident Slack channel: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C02INC22456
- Canaries dashboard (latency/failed-audits): https://dash.redwood.com/d/priv-sync/canary-22456
- GitHub PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/3187, https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/3199, https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-gateway/pull/1221
- Backfill job: https://internal.redwood.com/jobs/5462/backfills/kms-metadata
- Smoke test artifacts and step-by-step runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=private-sync-incident-22456

Acceptance criteria for Done:
- Backfill completes and audit table shows no missing kms_key_id for customers between 2026-03-13T22:00Z and 2026-03-14T06:00Z.
- Control-plane delta-applier implements durable commit-before-ack and passes full integration suite.
- Node-agent atomic apply landed and validated in private canary clusters.
- Identity gateway normalization tests added and passing.
- Postmortem published and customers confirmed resolution.
